title: Mastermind
name: Inner strategist
summary: Holds a long-range inner picture of how things should unfold, and then builds, in the shared world, the systems by which that picture might be made real without being sold too soon to mere usefulness.
myth:
INTJ are the thinkers of thinkers, bringing other worlds (Ni) into the physical world (Te). If any one type were to be the genius archetype, INTJ would be it. They move silently through the world, adding their genius in little bits, here and there. 

Ni leading, Te supporting — INTJ’s working pair.

The inner picture leads.

Introverted intuition sees a destination first: a shape of how things should go, not a to-do list. You often “know” the end before you have steps, money, or a team.

Extraverted thinking builds a world that can carry it.

Te’s job is not to invent the picture. It is to put the picture into time: calendars, systems, other people’s work. The road gets furnished after the destination is already seen.
tension: Introverted feeling, seated in the child, wants loyalty to a private ethic which the extraverted-thinking parent may treat as inefficient, while extraverted sensation in the inferior is the body and the moment you would rather postpone; the stack works when thinking remains a servant of the picture rather than a substitute for it, and when feeling is allowed to veto a clever plan that is not, in the end, yours to want.
inTheDay: Mornings often belong to the inner object, a problem rearranging itself while the kettle boils, and the day goes well when extraverted thinking is allowed to sequence that picture into actual hours, and poorly when you live only in the destination, skip the sensory middle, and then call the world incompetent for not having arrived with you, as if matter itself were a delay in the vision.
atWork: You are most useful where a horizon is required — architecture, strategy, a design that must still be true in three years — for atmosphere-only meetings drain you and meetings that decide a structure restore you, and you can become icy if the aim keeps changing without being named, titles mattering less to you than whether the work is permitted to be internally consistent.
withOthers: You tend to love by taking someone’s future seriously, which can feel like devotion or like being managed, and the child’s introverted feeling is a real loyalty, often unspoken, so that people may not know they have it until they lose it; those who lead with extraverted sensation can magnetize and unnerve you, living in the room you postpone, while extraverted-feeling climates can feel like a demand to perform a warmth you have not yet privately assented to.
auxiliaryHealing: For INTJ the dominant–inferior schism is introverted intuition against extraverted sensation: the inner picture of where things tend, set against the uncooperative present the picture would rather postpone. Extraverted thinking, seated as parent, is the sublimation. It heals the Ni–Se schism by giving the image a standard others can check — a structure that can carry the trajectory in time — so the vision meets the world as work rather than as a binge of sensation or a contempt for matter. Te is how Ni pays its debt to the object without having to become Se.
antiTypeStress: For INTJ under stress the anti-type is INFP. The inner picture, which extraverted thinking would have built into a world, can dissolve into a private court of introverted feeling and a restless extraverted-intuition of other lives: the plan is treated as a betrayal of the soul, systems become suspect, and you wander unused doors as if wandering were a verdict. You may look like a dreamer who has decided engineering was a moral error. It is a stress costume — Fi-ish purity where Te would have checked a result, Ne-ish maybe where Ni had a trajectory — and it is not a conversion. The architect has not become an idealist; the idealist is what the schism wears when the parent is too tired to give the image a standard others can check.
growth: Let the vision be tested in time and matter, for small sensory commitments — to finish, to ship, to stand in the room, to eat when you said you would — educate introverted intuition without humiliating it, even as extraverted thinking grows by checking results rather than announcing them, and introverted feeling grows by being spoken before the plan is already rolling and therefore too expensive to stop.
shadowWork: Extraverted intuition as opposing argues with your own vision in the other attitude, a hail of alternatives that feels like sabotage, while introverted thinking as senex calls your extraverted thinking crude, extraverted feeling as trickster binds you in social double messages, and introverted sensation as demon may erupt as a punitive private history, a body that will not be ignored, or a sudden crusade about how things always were; the work is not to become an extraverted sensing type, but to give sensation chosen contact before it takes the wheel, and to notice when the demon is driving what you have named a moral emergency.
prompts: What is the image I am serving, and what would count, in the world of objects, as evidence that it is landing?
Where did I skip a step because I already knew, and what did the skipped matter know that I did not?
What would a kind extraverted-thinking parent actually schedule in this week, if kindness and not mere speed were the standard?
When did extraverted sensation — the actual scene — last correct me, and did I thank it or only endure it?
Which introverted-feeling value is being treated as a rounding error in a plan I still call my own?
If I could not explain the future, even to myself, what would I consent to do in the next hour?
tagline: The visionary builder who transforms ideas into systems.
bridge: So INTJ often uses insight (Ni) to build structures others can inhabit (Te).
pattern: I see where reality is heading, and I build the structure needed to reach it.

title: Sage
name: Precise analyst
summary: Takes ideas apart until the inner logic holds, and then branches, by extraverted intuition, into the new cases the model still cannot answer, preferring a true unfinished thought to a useful false close.
myth: It is the inner model that leads, and extraverted intuition that keeps feeding it new cases, so that understanding is the craft, and you would rather the idea be true than useful, keeping the laboratory open until the contradiction yields, or until the world has moved on without a verdict, which to you is a lesser tragedy than a conclusion reached too soon.
tension: Introverted sensation in the child wants the familiar lab, the known tools, the joke that still works, while extraverted feeling in the inferior is the human weather you cannot model in advance, and extraverted intuition as parent keeps offering new specimens, so that the danger is a life of unfinished theories and of relationships treated as ill-posed problems, which they are, and which they are not only.
inTheDay: Time disappears into a definition, and you may emerge from a thread of thought unsure whether it has been twenty minutes or four hours, so that the day needs a container of introverted sensation — a meal, a walk, a stopping rule — or extraverted intuition will keep the hunt open until the body files a complaint in a language you are late to translate.
atWork: You shine where a model is wrong in an interesting way, in research, systems, debugging, the question nobody wanted to ask, while status meetings and forced enthusiasm are expensive, and you can stall a project by refusing to ship a good-enough version, or by vanishing into a more elegant framing while others wait for a decision that, to you, is still a premature closing of the case.
withOthers: You often relate through the problem, so that people who can play in the idea feel close, and people who need a feeling acknowledged first can feel like a different species; inferior extraverted feeling may show as sudden charm, sudden freeze, or a belated apology more accurate than warm, and you may underestimate how much your withdrawal is already a message, and a complete one.
auxiliaryHealing: For INTP the dominant–inferior schism is introverted thinking against extraverted feeling: the idea that must be consistent, set against the human weather that will not sit still for a definition. Extraverted intuition, seated as parent, is the sublimation. It heals the Ti–Fe schism by taking the private model out into specimens, other minds, unused doors, so the idea is socialized as possibility rather than dumped, crude, onto the room as a plea to be liked or a freeze in any we. Ne is how Ti meets other people without having to become Fe.
antiTypeStress: For INTP under stress the anti-type is INFJ. The open laboratory, which extraverted intuition would have socialized, can close into a single inner picture and a borrowed extraverted-feeling climate: the model is no longer tested but preached, people are shepherded toward a meaning they did not ask to inhabit, and you speak as if the we had a soul you alone can hear. You may look like a mystic who has forgotten to keep the case open. It is stress — Ni-ish fate where Ne would have kept specimens coming, Fe-ish weather where Ti would have asked whether the definition holds — not a new type. The sage has not become a counselor; the counsel is what shows when the idea cannot bear the human room and so tries to convert it.
growth: Publish the incomplete model and let other people use it, for extraverted feeling grows by being in the room rather than by a better theory of the room, and introverted sensation grows by repeating a few humane routines until they are boring enough to trust, which is a higher praise of boredom than the culture of novelty will allow.
shadowWork: Extraverted thinking as opposing will try to win by metrics and force a close, while introverted feeling as senex judges your whole character from a private ethic you did not know you had, extraverted sensation as trickster dumps you into impulse or numbness, and introverted intuition as demon arrives as fate, doom, or a revelation that cannot be argued with; after a collapse, ask which of those took the wheel before you redesign the personality, as if the personality were only a better model of the same crash.
prompts: What definition am I polishing instead of testing, and whom does the polish protect?
Which possibility offered by extraverted intuition is a delay, and which is a real next case the model still cannot answer?
Where did I disappear from a relationship because it was logically messy, and what feeling was the mess trying to be?
What would good enough to share look like today, if sharing were part of the method and not a betrayal of it?
What fact of introverted sensation — sleep, food, a promise — is the model ignoring as if matter were an error term?
If I spoke one true extraverted-feeling sentence, not a theory of feeling but a sentence, what would it be?
tagline: The one who takes the idea apart until it holds, and then looks for the next case it cannot yet answer.
bridge: So INTP often uses inner logic (Ti) to open new cases and possibilities (Ne).
pattern: I want the model to be true, and I keep the field open until the contradiction yields.

title: Architect-King
name: Directive organizer
summary: Moves people and plans toward a visible goal, guided by a sense of the most effective path, and by an inner picture of where the whole campaign is tending, which extraverted thinking then undertakes to make happen.
myth: It is the outer order that leads, and introverted intuition that supplies the long arc, so that you move people and systems toward a result that should exist, and the wager is that a world can be organized until the right thing happens, hesitation being usually a luxury the problem cannot afford, though the problem, being human, can afford more than the plan admits.
tension: Extraverted sensation in the child loves the win in the moment — the close, the room, the proof — while introverted feeling in the inferior is the private cost you notice late, often in someone else’s face, and introverted intuition as parent can bless a campaign that is strategically beautiful and humanly expensive, which is a blessing that will one day ask to be paid.
inTheDay: The day is a sequence of objectives, and you wake already in motion, rest being something you schedule if you respect it or something that arrives as illness if you do not, while the sensing child wants a hit of now — a workout, a deal, a night that proves you are still sharp — as if sharpness were the same thing as being alive.
atWork: You are built for command of a shared standard, to build, scale, cut, and decide, and you lose patience with process that cannot name its output, the shadow of this gift being the conversion of people into throughput; you are more trusted when you can say what you are optimizing for, including what you are willing to sacrifice, for unnamed sacrifice is still sacrifice, only less honest.
withOthers: You often love by taking responsibility for the outcome, so that partners may feel protected and steamrolled in the same week, and inferior introverted feeling can appear as unexplained loyalty, unexplained ice, or a moral recoil you cannot yet articulate; those who lead with introverted feeling may look like the missing heart of the operation and like a threat to speed, which is a double image worth sitting with rather than resolving too quickly.
auxiliaryHealing: For ENTJ the dominant–inferior schism is extraverted thinking against introverted feeling: the campaign that can be shown, set against the private cost noticed late, often in someone else’s face. Introverted intuition, seated as parent, is the sublimation. It heals the Te–Fi schism by giving the plan a trajectory that is not merely faster — an inner picture of where this is tending, and whether that destination is still the one — so Te is steered before Fi has to arrive as guilt, crusade, or collapse. Ni is how Te grows a conscience that is not yet a feeling function.
antiTypeStress: For ENTJ under stress the anti-type is ENFP. The campaign, which introverted intuition would have given a true destination, can scatter into unused doors and a sudden private hurt: extraverted intuition opens every alternative, introverted feeling arrives as an unexplained veto, and the plan is abandoned as if abandoning it were a moral awakening. You may look like a spark who has decided outcomes were a kind of violence. It is a stress costume — Ne-ish field where Te would have closed, Fi-ish injury where Ni would have asked where this is still tending — and it is not a softer type discovered late. The general has not become a wanderer; the wandering is weather, and the stack, when the weather lifts, is still ENTJ.
growth: Build a pause for value that is not a veto from guilt but a genuine question of introverted feeling — whether this is still yours to want — and let introverted intuition be a true trajectory rather than a story that merely makes extraverted thinking faster, even as extraverted sensation may celebrate without being asked to serve as the only proof that you exist.
shadowWork: Introverted thinking as opposing deconstructs your plan from inside the idea, while introverted sensation as senex says you should have known and have always known, extraverted intuition as trickster opens twelve exits when you needed one no, and extraverted feeling as demon can erupt as a public feeling-storm or a ruthless use of the group; integration is letting introverted feeling speak in private before the demon borrows a crowd, which it will, if the private speech is refused.
prompts: What result am I organizing that I have not actually chosen, and whose wanting am I wearing as my own?
Who is paying the introverted-feeling cost of this plan, and have they been told they are paying it?
Where is introverted intuition a true trajectory, and where is it only a story that makes extraverted thinking faster?
What would I do if efficiency were not the virtue, and which other virtue have I been starving in its name?
When did the sensing child turn a win into a substitute for meaning, and did the room applaud the substitution?
What would I admit if I were not in charge of the room, and would the admission still be true if I were?
tagline: The one who moves people and systems toward a result that should exist.
bridge: So ENTJ often uses outer order (Te) in the service of a long inner arc (Ni).
pattern: I see the path that should exist, and I organize the world until it does.

title: Trickster Inventor
name: Inventive debater
summary: Opens possibilities in the object-world and in conversation, and then pressure-tests them for inner consistency, keeping the field from hardening too soon, and sometimes from hardening at all.
myth: It is the field of possibilities that leads, and introverted thinking that pressure-tests them, so that debate is often love of the idea rather than of winning, and you keep the world from hardening too soon, which is a service, and you can keep it from hardening at all, which is a different service and not always a kindness.
tension: Extraverted feeling in the child wants the room to sparkle, while introverted sensation in the inferior is the boring continuity that makes a possibility real, and introverted thinking as parent will dismantle a charming plan, after which the child may perform warmth to keep the audience while the idea is already gone, a theatre of relation covering a vacated thought.
inTheDay: The day branches, and you may start three lives before noon and mean all of them, so that without a through-line of introverted sensation — sleep, a repeating block of work, one kept appointment — the brilliance becomes a weather system, and food and inboxes are easy to treat as optional scenery in a play whose next act has not been written.
atWork: You belong where a problem is still ill-formed, in invention, argument, the pivot nobody has permission to name, and you stall where the work is repetition without a new question; people may love the spark and then not know who will still be there on Tuesday, so that the adult work is to name the Tuesday and remain on it, which is a smaller glory and a larger one.
withOthers: You often bond by playing, the feeling child wanting to be liked in the riff while thinking wants the riff to be true, so that partners can feel endlessly interesting and not quite chosen; those who keep the archive of introverted sensation may look like a jail until you notice they are how a possibility becomes a life, which is a conversion extraverted intuition cannot perform alone.
auxiliaryHealing: For ENTP the dominant–inferior schism is extraverted intuition against introverted sensation: the open field, set against the boring continuity that makes a possibility real. Introverted thinking, seated as parent, is the sublimation. It heals the Ne–Si schism by requiring the idea to hold — one model finished far enough to be used — so Ne is refined rather than left to dump its unfinished lives onto the inferior as homesickness, hypochondria, or a desperate return to a yesterday that no longer exists. Ti is how Ne keeps a thread without having to become Si.
antiTypeStress: For ENTP under stress the anti-type is ENFJ. The open field, which introverted thinking would have refined, can collapse into a climate you suddenly must manage: extraverted feeling takes the room’s temperature as a task, introverted intuition supplies a singular meaning the group is failing to live, and the riff is replaced by a ministry. You may look like a host who has decided play was irresponsible. It is stress — Fe-ish caretaking where Ne would have kept the doors open, Ni-ish one-story where Ti would have asked the model to hold — not a conversion. The wit has not become a shepherd; the shepherding is what the schism wears when the inferior is already knocking and the parent is too tired to keep a thread.
growth: Pick one thread and keep it for a season, for introverted sensation is not death but the means by which extraverted intuition becomes a life, and let introverted thinking finish a model far enough to be used, and extraverted feeling be care rather than a good show, which will cost you some of the room’s sparkle and return you something the sparkle could not buy.
shadowWork: Introverted intuition as opposing insists on one fate against your many doors, while introverted feeling as senex issues a private moral grade you cannot argue with in public terms, extraverted sensation as trickster dumps you into impulse, appetite, or a scene you will not remember clearly, and extraverted thinking as demon may tyrannize in a sudden brutal plan or collapse into impotence about ever getting anything done; after the wreck, restore one fact of sensation and one honest no, which together are more of a life than twelve unused doors.
prompts: Which option am I keeping open only to avoid choosing, and what would the choice cost me that the open door does not?
What did I deconstruct this week that someone needed to stay standing, and did I stay to rebuild?
Where could extraverted feeling be care rather than performance, even if the room sparkled a little less?
What small routine of introverted sensation would actually serve the idea I love, rather than insult it?
Whom did I charm instead of tell, and what would the telling have required of me?
If this possibility had to survive three months of Tuesdays, would I still want it, and would I still be there?
tagline: The one who keeps the world from hardening too soon, and pressure-tests whatever would close it.
bridge: So ENTP often uses possibility (Ne) and then tests it for inner consistency (Ti).
pattern: I open the field, and I will not let a charming plan stand if it does not follow.

title: Dreamer
name: Quiet idealist
summary: Protects an inner sense of what matters, often before it can be justified in public terms, and then explores the many lives in which that compass might still be true.

It heals the Se–Ni schism by naming what this is worth — a private yes that can outlast the lighting — so Se is not only the scene, and Ni need not arrive as conspiracy, fatal prophecy, or a sudden refusal to live in any future at all. Fi is how the night becomes a life, without the inferior having to invent a destiny in the dark.
antiTypeStress: For ESFP under stress the anti-type is ESTJ. Presence in the given, usually parented by a private yes, can harden into management: extraverted thinking issues orders, introverted sensation cites how it has always been done, and the night is no longer lived but run. You may look like a supervisor of the party who has forgotten they came to be in it. It is a stress costume — Te-ish command where Se would have stayed with the object, Si-ish custom where Fi would have named what this was worth — and it is not a newly discovered seriousness. The lights are still ESFP; the clipboard is weather.
growth: Let introverted feeling name what the night was for, and a little introverted intuition with extraverted thinking can turn a gift for presence into a life, not only a scene; the thinking child can serve the value — money, time, a boundary — without becoming a tyrant of the vibe, which is a stewardship the hero of extraverted sensation does not naturally admire and which the life, if it is to last, will require.
shadowWork: Introverted sensation as opposing argues from the inner archive against this moment, while introverted thinking as senex picks the joy apart, extraverted intuition as trickster offers too many next scenes, and extraverted feeling as demon uses the room, charm as a door closing, or a collapse into needing the crowd; after a grip of introverted intuition, do not swear off meaning, but ask introverted feeling what was true and then let extraverted sensation live it tomorrow on purpose, which is how the inferior is answered without being allowed to become a religion of fate.
prompts: What was I performing, and what did I actually feel, and can those two accounts be told in the same sentence?
Where would a bit of extraverted thinking protect the thing I love, rather than police the vibe that surrounds it?
What pattern of introverted intuition keeps repeating in my spontaneous choices, and what would it mean to choose it awake?
Who sees me when the room is quiet, and have I let them, or only the room when it is loud?
What would I refuse if attention were not the currency, and is that refusal a loss of life or the beginning of one?
What is this week for, in one sentence of introverted feeling, spoken before the night begins to invent a meaning of its own?
tagline: The one who brings a room to life, and then, if honest, asks whether the night was true.
bridge: So ESFP uses the living present (Se) kept from empty display by a private standard (Fi).
pattern: I bring the room to life, and I ask whether the night was true as well as vivid.
